question: If I cast Stream of Thought with replicate and it is countered, do I still get the copies for each time I paid the replicate cost?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you copy the spell for each time you paid the replicate cost, even if it is countered.
expected.answer: You’ll copy Stream of Thought for each time you paid its replicate cost, even if it’s countered.

whyHard: The copies are made when the replicate trigger resolves, which can be after the original was countered in response to that trigger, so players expect the counter to take the copies with it.
